text:
alejandra: 🚨 seeing spike of 503s from hosted inference gateway for a bunch of customers. internal metrics show gateway returning 503s and upstream inference pool healthy-ish. opening war room.

mike: on it. can you paste the top logs and a sample request id?

sara: customer reports: multiple 503s since ~08:12 UTC, pretty persistent for requests hitting /v1/generate. ticket #CS-4721

alejandra: sample request_id=req_0a9b3c, logs: `gateway error: upstream response 503` repeated. no immediate correlation to model or region in dashboard, but traffic from us-east-1 heavy.

ben: checking circuit-breaker metrics. there was a rollout of cb-policy v2 at 08:05 UTC to gateways-prod. failure_count jumped around 08:11. looks suspicious.

kai: i'm putting the gateway target group into readonly routing to reduce blast. will route new traffic to fallback nodes.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for cb-policy v2 -> gateways-prod by ben at 2026-03-15T08:06:12Z

mike: can someone grep gateway logs for `cb-policy v2` and `token` errors? I want to see if auth failures triggered breakers.

alejandra: grep shows many `upstream transport error: context canceled` and later `circuit-breaker tripped: backend_unavailable` logs.

sara: customer says they saw `504` then `503`. sequence: initial timeout then gateway 503. maybe retry loop amplified.

ben: my rollout changed default socket timeout from 1.2s -> 700ms for fast failover. that might be too aggressive under variable tail latencies.

mike: aha. if we reduced timeout to 700ms, downstream models with occasional 800-900ms tails will hit timeout then CB increment. that explains rising failure_count.

nisha: several enterprise customers on Dedicated also reported similar symptoms but at lower volume; hosted customers hit hardest due to autoscaler trying to spread.

oliver: product note: rollout intended to reduce customer p99 but we didn't throttle gradual-enough. need rollback.

kai: mitigation plan: 1) rollback cb-policy to previous config 2) increase socket timeout back to 1.5s 3) enable graceful degraded responses (model-fallback) 4) reduce aggressive retries from caller side. executing 1 now.

ben: rolling back cb-policy v2 -> v1 now. `kubectl -n gateway apply -f cb-policy-v1.yaml`

deploy-bot: Rollback invoked by ben at 2026-03-15T08:20:45Z

mike: monitoring error rates... still elevated but dropping. p50/p95 latency unaffected, p99 dropping back slowly.

alejandra: need immediate customer comms. Sara, can you message affected customers with ETA and explain temporary rollback and follow-up postmortem?

sara: ack. drafting message: "We observed transient 503s caused by a gateway config change. We've rolled back and are monitoring. We'll follow up with root cause and action items." sending now to list of impacted orgs.

sara: sent DM to CS list and posted in #support with incident flag. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

mike: reproduction notes: run curl against endpoint w/ long prompt; with old timeout it completes, with 700ms setting it times out. example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-7b","input":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":512}'
```

ben: added a temporary canary to block cb-policy v2 for 24h and only allow it in a throttled subset. patch KR deployed.

kai: we've disabled aggressive client-side retries at the loadbalancer for now: setting `retry_policy.max_attempts=1` until we verify stability.

alejandra: good. action items for postmortem:
- A1: revert default timeout change in rollout pipeline (owner: ben)
- A2: add preflight perf tests for cb changes hitting p99 tails (owner: mike)
- A3: improve rollout gating: phased canary + automated error surge abort (owner: oliver)
- A4: update runbook to include rollback playbook for cb trips (owner: kai)
- A5: customer communication template and CS playbook (owner: nisha/sara)

ben: noting A1 done (patch queued) - will follow up with PR link in followup thread.

mike: A2: I'll add a load profile job that includes long tail synthetic prompts and run it in CI before cb policy promotes.

oliver: A3: we'll add an automated abort: if gateway 5xx rate > 0.5% in 5m, rollback. I'll PR the policy.

nisha: A5: adding recommended customer note for enterprise customers with SLAs about increased observability and optional dedicated capacity to avoid noisy neighbor effects.

sara: also captured step-by-step repro in support ticket with curl example and attached logs.

alejandra: timeline for postmortem doc: draft in 24h, final in 72h. Assigning owners accordingly.

ben: posting immediate followup to #eng-releases with rollback summary and reminder to hold feature flags for 48h.

mike: follow-up checks: confirm no ongoing elevated 5xx and validate model pool saturation metrics.

kai: closing war room in 30m if metrics look stable. leaving monitoring alerts at higher sensitivity for next 6h.

incident-bot: Incident 1949993333 changed status -> mitigated by alejandro at 2026-03-15T09:00:25Z

alejandra: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene if anything bubbles up. good catch on the timeout delta.

sara: adding postmortem checklist to ticket CS-4721 and pinging customers with postmortem link later.

mike: raw config diff (reverted):
```
- socket.timeout: 700ms
+ socket.timeout: 1500ms
```

ben: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/policies/1234 revert cb-policy timeout change (will paste link in postmortem)

nisha: tagging key customer contacts who were impacted and confirming follow-up meeting scheduled at 2026-03-16T15:00 UTC.

alejandra: thread summary: root cause was overly aggressive circuit-breaker/socket timeout rollout (cb-policy v2) that didn't account for p99 model tail latency -> triggered cascaded 503s. Mitigations: rollback, increased timeout, reduced retries, canary block. Action items assigned.
